description: One place for Dataverse / Dynamics 365 security administration. Explore who has which security roles and teams, compare users, find which roles grant a privilege on a table, and spot forgotten users, roles and teams. Change security safely: assign roles to users and teams, manage team membership and clone a user's profile, with a review of every change first, an undo, and an optional restore file.
releaseNotes: 2.1.0: A simpler menu, 17 screens down to 13 entries. A user's access, with three question tabs: what can they do, why do they have access, and can they open this record; the selected user follows from tab to tab. Compare, with two users, two roles and, new, two environments (Dev against Prod through a second connection: roles only on one side, privileges and team roles that differ). Assign, with roles for users, roles for teams and team membership. Explain access and Compare state their question and answer in one sentence ("Why can Ada [Read] on [Account]? Yes, at Organization level"); the two users or roles can be picked in the sentence. New: Application users, listed apart from people with their roles; Column security, by profile or by user; the Privilege finder also finds roles by the privileges that are not about a table (Export to Excel, Bulk Delete...); the Cleanup report finds roles that add nothing and can remove them; the review of every role or team change shows what each user gains or loses. 1.5.0: Move from one screen to the next: right-click a user, team, role or table in any list or in the Users and teams tree and open another screen with it already selected, or copy cells and rows. A search box in the title bar (Ctrl+K) finds any user, team, role or table and lists the last items you opened. The tool reopens on the screen you last used in each environment and keeps the options you ticked. F5 refreshes and Ctrl+E exports on every screen, and the command bar says when the data was read. The Privilege finder takes one, several or all privileges at once, with a depth column per privilege. Excel exports are now styled workbooks: coloured header, filters, frozen header row, privilege depths in colour, print settings and an About sheet saying what was exported, from which environment and when. New icon. 1.3.0: New Record access screen: pick a user or team and a record (paste its link or id, or search by name) and see for each right whether they have it and why, with who the record is shared with. Role holders gets a Teams tab beside the Users tab, with counts. The Users and teams tree shows the user in bold with their business unit, and teams with theirs. A user's access takes one user at a time. 1.2.1: Fixes privileges for roles that sit in a child business unit. Their privileges live on the root role, so Explain access, A user's access, Two roles and Privileged users found none for them; each copy now uses its root role's privileges. A privilege that stands for the same action on several tables now counts for each table, and Explain access says how many roles it checked when it finds no route. 1.2.0: The menu is grouped by intent (Look up, Understand access, Compare, Review, Change) with foldable groups and a Find a screen box. New: Compare roles, and Business units (the hierarchy as a tree, merging the old Users by business unit). The Cleanup report can remove disabled users from teams and strip their roles, with the usual review and undo. A question-led Home page, a How it works line on every screen, empty states that say what to do, and privilege depths drawn with the Dynamics 365 icons everywhere. Explain access reads only the roles the selected users hold. Compare users always shows the business unit line. 1.1.0: New Explain access (why can this user do this?), What can a user do? (every table against the eight privileges, in the style of the Dynamics 365 security role editor) and Privileged users (roles that can delete across the organization and who holds them). 1.0.1: Packaging update only, no functional changes. 1.0.0: First release. Explore: users and teams, team members, users by role, users by business unit, privilege finder, compare users and a cleanup report. Change: assign roles to users and to teams, manage team membership and clone a user profile; every change is reviewed before it is applied and can be undone.
title: Security Toolkit
